data.body_html:
Ring in 2035 with a front-row seat to Marbella's legendary New Year's Eve fireworks from the water. A new years eve boat rental marbella 2034 offers a private, glamorous alternative to crowded beachfront bars or hotel rooftops. Depart from Puerto Banús, anchor off Marbella Marina or Cabopino, and watch the midnight sky explode in colour while sipping cava. Our fleet accommodates 5 to 12 guests, all charters include a skipper, drinks, and snacks—no hidden costs. Book early; these slots vanish by November.

Why Choose a Boat for NYE 2034 Fireworks

Marbella's NYE fireworks are launched from the coast between Puerto Banús and Cabopino. On a private boat, you get an unobstructed 360° view, no crowds, and the freedom to dance, dine, or simply soak it in. The average December evening temperature is 14°C, so the sea is calm, and the sky is clear. Your skipper handles navigation and anchoring, leaving you to enjoy the moment.

Our Fleet for New Year's Eve 2034

We offer a range of boats departing from Puerto Banús. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski and costs €4,719 for a 4-hour minimum. For a more intimate celebration, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) start at €1,499 for 4 hours. Smaller options like the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) are available on request via WhatsApp. All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish IVA.

What's Included in Your NYE Charter

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No hidden extras. You can bring your own food and decorations. The galley has a fridge and icebox.

Best Views of the Fireworks

The fireworks are launched near Marbella Marina and Cabopino. Our skippers know the best anchor spots based on wind direction and tide. Typically, we position off the coast of the Golden Mile, offering a direct line of sight to the display. From Puerto Banús, it's a 15-minute cruise to the prime viewing area. You'll see the reflection of the fireworks on the water—a spectacle impossible from land.

How to Book Your NYE 2034 Boat Rental

Contact us via WhatsApp for availability. A 50% deposit secures your slot. Full payment is due 14 days before departure. Cancellations up to 30 days before are fully refundable. We recommend booking by mid-November 2034. For more details on our fleet and pricing, visit our boat rental Marbella hub.

Sample NYE 2034 Itinerary

TimeActivity
20:00Depart Puerto Banús, sunset cruise along the coast
21:30Anchor off Marbella Marina, enjoy drinks and snacks

This 4-hour charter covers the entire experience comfortably. You can extend to 6 hours for an earlier start or later return—pricing on request.

All NYE charters require a minimum of 4 hours to ensure you're on the water for the full fireworks display and return safely. Tier A boats start at €1,499 for 4 hours, while Tier B boats are €4,719 for 4 hours.

Yes, our boats anchor in prime positions off Marbella Marina and Cabopino, offering unobstructed views of the midnight fireworks. The skipper will choose the best spot based on wind and tide.

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, Spanish IVA (21%), soft drinks, water, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. No hidden extras.

We recommend departing at 20:00 to enjoy the sunset cruise, anchor by 23:30 for the countdown, and return by 01:00. The 4-hour charter covers this timing perfectly.

No strict dress code, but bring warm layers as it can get chilly on the water in December. The boat provides blankets. No open-toe heels on deck for safety.
